name: 案件一覧と健全性の集計ペイン
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0072 Japanese three-project table with health-summary side pane, one complete catalog component.
Original image1 full/image2 crop PRIMARY for all content/states, original icon anatomy/optical weight, artwork, grouping/width proportions and fine details. Image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese content/compact height; its uniform substitute icons/minted avatars/missing status column are wrong.
Wide logical1200x500 WHITE component/canvas. LEFT about69% table, RIGHT31% white rounded fine-outline side pane spanning height, restrained shadow; no other cards/main title/app sidebar. Compact table at top, intentional blank area beneath, no invented rows.
LEFT header「名称」「健全性」「優先度」「責任者」「目標日」「状態」, all six visible before pane, original broad name column/compact right indicators.
Exactly3 rows:
1 original gray document art「利用者の声と行動の集計…」, amber hollow diamond +「目的の共有…」(hidden complete milestone unknown); health original pale-green circle/green rising zigzag; priority original orange square/white!; lead original purple AM avatar;「4月15日」; original amber hex-outline/circular-wedge active status.
2 original headphone glyph「利用者体験の調査支援」, amber diamond + known「目的の共有と整理」; health gray EMPTY DASHED circle; priority original three ascending gray bars; lead purple AM;「4月24日」; active amber status EXACTLY SAME glyph/interior/orientation as row1, not different progress.
3 original blue-purple heart/white pulse art「初回利用の改善」, milestone EMPTY; health empty gray dashed circle; priority gray ascending bars; lead original UNASSIGNED DASHED PERSON placeholder; target date EMPTY; status orange EMPTY DOTTED HEXAGON. Do not fill empty cells or use mint initials.
RIGHT two equal small pill tabs「健全性」「責任者」; 健全性 selected forest-green gradient/white label, other white fine-outline pill/slate label. Three summary rows each count「1」right-aligned:
original pale-green circle/green rising zigzag「順調」1;
original AMBER DASHED circular outline with amber rising zigzag「更新なし」1;
original EMPTY GRAY DASHED CIRCLE「更新予定なし」1.
Match original zigzag/dash glyph geometry, no diagonal-arrow/checkmark/empty-circle substitutions in first two.
Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0, no bold headings/body. Pure-white surfaces; slate utility glyphs, purposeful source green/amber/orange state distinctions, protected purple/blue artwork. Selected gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, no mint panels/gloss. No extra actions/values/rows/metrics.
reviewNotes: Six columns/three distinct project states plus health summary labels/counts1 and original amber/green zigzags restored. Row1/2 active interiors differ and third dotted status became circular rather than hexagonal; retain pending, prior related status edit ineffective. All source-empty fields remain empty.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
